_schema: The brand's single topic register, shared by Instagram and LinkedIn drafting. `used` is appended by publish.mjs when a post goes out and by hand when a LinkedIn post runs. `rejected` lists claims that never run uncorrected; the correction series may cite them as the claim being corrected.

used.topic: Statistical learning: 8-month-olds segment words from a continuous speech stream after 2 minutes

rejected.claim: Hamlin et al. helper/hinderer paradigm (infants prefer helpers)
rejected.why: Failed to replicate in Lucca et al. (2025), ManyBabies, 1,018 infants
Contested; Sperry et al. (2019) failed to replicate; Dailey & Bergelson (2022) meta-analysis finds a much smaller, count-dependent difference

rejected.claim: Marshmallow test / delay of gratification predicts life outcomes
rejected.why: Effect substantially attenuated in Watts, Duncan & Quan (2018), n = 918

_note: The eight legacy carousels above were rebuilt as the first One study posts in marketing/instagram/posts/; publish.mjs records each here under `used` when it publishes.
